## 💰 Money Empire — start broke, become a billionaire

**▶ Play in your browser:** https://jaineil32624.github.io/money-empire/play/
**🌐 Website:** https://jaineil32624.github.io/money-empire/

| Download | File |
|---|---|
| 📱 Android | `MoneyEmpire.apk` — allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser / file manager |
| 🪟 Windows | `MoneyEmpire.exe` — single file, just run it (SmartScreen: *More info → Run anyway*) |
| 🐧 Linux | `MoneyEmpire.x86_64` — `chmod +x` then run |
| 🖥️ Dedicated server | `MoneyEmpireServer.x86_64 -- --server --port 7777` (headless, up to 100 players) |
| 🌐 Web | `MoneyEmpire-web.zip` — host on any static server |
| 📦 Source | *Source code (zip)* — open `project.godot` in Godot 4.3 |

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jaineil32624/money-empire/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's new.

> The APK is signed with a debug key for testing. For Google Play, export the **Android AAB (Play Store)** preset with your own upload keystore.
